_help.awardsFor2: End screen: how many highlight awards show in a 2-player game.
_help.awardsFor3: How many highlight awards show in a 3-player game.
_help.awardsFor4: How many highlight awards show in a 4-player game.
_help.awardPriority: Which awards may show, and in what order they are picked: 1 = picked first. 0 = never shown. No player gets a second award until everyone has one. Awards never add Magic.
_help.photoFinishMax: Photo finish: the winner won by this much Magic or less (it then replaces The deciding turn).
_help.comebackMin: Comeback: the winner must have been behind by at least this much Magic at some point.
_help.twoBirdsMin: Two birds: the most words in one cast must be at least this many.
_help.secretLeaderMinRounds: Secret leader: led (alone) after at least this many rounds.
_help.generousMin: Generous gardener: at least this many of a player's seeds were used in rivals' words.
_help.maxMarkers: Story chart: the most moment markers drawn on the lines (tangles first, then award moments, then lead changes).
_help.chartDrawSeconds: Story chart: how long the lines take to draw themselves in, left to right, when the page opens (0 = at once; reduce motion = at once).
_help.chartLineWidth: Story chart: line thickness, in chart units (the chart is 360 wide).
_help.chartHeight: Story chart: its smallest height, in px (it grows to fill the page).
_help.pageFill: Results and Scorecard pages: everything on the page grows until it fills this share of the page's height (0.94 = 94%), so a big screen isn't a small page floating in empty space. Never smaller than normal size.
_help.maxZoom: Results and Scorecard pages: the most they may grow to fill a big screen (2.25 = 2¼ times normal size).
_help.awardPriority.photoFinish: Photo finish ("Won by just 2 Magic"): its place in the award order. 1 = picked first, 0 = never shown. No player gets a second award until everyone has one. Awards never add Magic.
_help.awardPriority.deciding: The deciding turn ("Took the lead for good in round 5"): its place in the award order (0 = never shown). Never shown together with Photo finish.
_help.awardPriority.biggestTurn: Biggest turn (most Magic in one cast): its place in the award order (0 = never shown).
_help.awardPriority.twoBirds: Two birds (several words from one seed): its place in the award order (0 = never shown).
_help.awardPriority.borrowedBloom: Borrowed bloom (a word grown mostly from rivals' seeds): its place in the award order (0 = never shown).
_help.awardPriority.knotTier: Knot tier (tangled a rival's glyphling): its place in the award order (0 = never shown). Never shown together with Brave knot.
_help.awardPriority.braveKnot: Brave knot (tangled their own glyphling to end the game): its place in the award order (0 = never shown).
_help.awardPriority.tangleHarvest: Tangle harvest (most Magic from tangles): its place in the award order (0 = never shown).
_help.awardPriority.comeback: Comeback (was far behind and still won): its place in the award order (0 = never shown).
_help.awardPriority.secretLeader: Secret leader (ahead for most rounds, and nobody knew): its place in the award order (0 = never shown).
_help.awardPriority.longestWord: Longest word: its place in the award order (0 = never shown).
_help.awardPriority.soloGrower: Solo grower (most Magic from words of only their own seeds): its place in the award order (0 = never shown).
_help.awardPriority.rareSeed: Rare seed (a word with Q, Z, X or J): its place in the award order (0 = never shown).
_help.awardPriority.generousGardener: Generous gardener (their seeds grew into rivals' words): its place in the award order (0 = never shown).
_help.awardPriority.freshStart: Fresh start (most Magic right after a refresh): its place in the award order (0 = never shown).

_labels.photoFinishMax: Photo finish: won by at most
_labels.comebackMin: Comeback: was behind by at least
_labels.twoBirdsMin: Two birds: words in one cast, at least
_labels.secretLeaderMinRounds: Secret leader: led after at least (rounds)
_labels.generousMin: Generous gardener: seeds given, at least
_labels.pageFill: Results pages: how much of the height to fill
_labels.maxZoom: Results pages: most they may grow
